rationale: Municipal enforcement action (TJSP) ordering the demolition of unauthorized concrete paving that exceeded statutory soil-impermeabilization limits within a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais). Under the calibrated protocol, Brazilian mananciais watershed protection enforcement is classified as WATER and environmental_protection; under strict_service_access_label, land-use/demolition enforcement in áreas de proteção de mananciais without direct water utility service or abstraction/pollution adjudication is coded UNCERTAIN.
